doc.title: Monthly Updates [December]
doc.html:
INFO These update threads only contain major updates. If you're interested in seeing all minor changes you can follow our Commits Page on GitHub or Updates Channel in Discord.

Wiki Updates

  • Added FFmpeg section to Video Tools.

  • Added Anti-Censorship section to Proxies.

  • Added Spotify Playlist Tools section to Audio.

  • Added Household Management section to Misc.

  • Added new subsections to YouTube: Video Tools / Playlist Tools / Archiving

  • Split Webhosting into subsections: Free Webhosting / Static Pages / Dynamic Pages / Site Builders

  • Split Smart TV and Android TV into separate sections.

  • Split Physical Health and Workout into separate sections.

  • Split Single Server and Free w/ Ads streaming into separate sections.

  • Moved IPTV Tools out of storage into its own dedicated section.

  • Cleaned up both DNS Resolver + VPN Config sections.

  • Went through AI section and tagged bots that don't require signup.

Stars Added ⭐

  • Starred Windows 10 After EOL in Windows Updates. Continue to receive updates after Win10's End-Of-Life in Oct 2025.

  • Starred Directory Opus in File Explorers. Powerful and highly customizable Windows file manager.

  • Starred Censorship Bypass Guide in Anti-Censorship. Easy-to-follow censorship bypass guides.

  • Starred Mistral in Online Chatbots. Feature-rich bot which includes web search, a canvas tool, image generation and more.

  • Starred OnTheSpot in Audio Ripping. Spotify Downloader with a GUI that still works after Spotify's changes.

  • Starred LanguageTool in Grammar Check. This seemed to pick up the most errors when compared to other options.

  • Starred BlockAway in Proxy Sites. Popular proxy site that seems to work well for most people.

  • Starred Plutonium in Multiplayer Mods. The most popular COD multiplayer server mod, works with multiple games.

  • Starred webOS Dev Manager in Smart TV. LG TV Homebrew Installer + Guide.

  • Starred Citrus Search in Academic Papers. Easily search and find similar papers for any topic.

Things Removed

  • Removed free WARP keys as they're being revoked now.

  • Removed DramaCool as they're shutting down. We're aware GogoAnime has also stopped updates, but we're waiting for more news before removing them.

  • Removed both SusFlix and BFlix as they've been offline for over a week.

  • Unstarred multiple streaming sites as we had so many stars they became meaningless. Before vs. After.

  • Unstarred Claude as the free tier is too limited now.

  • Unstarred ClearURLs as it's mostly redundant with adblockers like uBO.
